order-release.content: package quest.orders; public record OrderLine(int unitPrice,int quantity) { public OrderLine { if(unitPrice<0||quantity<0)throw new IllegalArgumentException(); } public int subtotal(){return unitPrice*quantity;} }

order-release.name: src/main/java/quest/orders/PricingService.java
order-release.content: package quest.orders; import java.util.List; public class PricingService { public static int total(List<OrderLine> lines,int discount){if(discount<0||discount>100)throw new IllegalArgumentException();int sum=0;for(OrderLine line:lines)sum+=line.subtotal();return sum*(100-discount)/100;} }
